entries.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
entries.description: OAuth client for Gmail and Google Drive access.
howToGet: In console.cloud.google.com, create a project, enable the Gmail and Drive APIs, and create an OAuth client ID (Web application).

entries.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
entries.description: Secret for the Google OAuth client.
howToGet: Shown next to the OAuth client ID in Google Cloud Console > APIs & Services > Credentials.

entries.name: GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI
entries.description: Where Google sends the owner back after granting access.
howToGet: Use https://<instance-host>/oauth/google/callback and add it to the OAuth client's authorized redirect URIs.
